{{Quote|Remember, your lightsaber is an invaluable tool. Even when inactive, it can defuse a potentially volatile situation. Trust me on that.|[[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
'''Form Zero''', while not an actual form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] per se but rather an ethical principle, was the idea that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] should know when to use their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and when to find an alternative means of solving a problem. This millennium principle is mentioned by [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi battlemaster]] [[Skarch Vaunk]] in ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' and was supported by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to address the need of the Jedi to restrain themselves when tempted to use "aggressive negotiations," and instead use another well-developed Jedi [[Force power/Legends|skill]], such as the Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]]. This was a form used to arrive at a solution without resorting to violence; one that was favored by [[Felanil Baaks]].

Yoda used to quote of the Tythonese Sky Judge [[Culoph]] who said: {{Quote|The best blades are kept in their sheaths.|The anonymous warrior|<ref name="JY">''[[Jedi: Yoda]]''</ref>}}
In the days of the [[New Jedi Order]], Jedi Master [[Kyle Katarn]] would teach his students, among whom were [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Rosh Penin]], that often the sight of an unignited lightsaber would be enough to cause individuals that might be potential enemies to become more cooperative. Katarn had applied this principle himself years earlier to extract information from an [[Baldarek|uncooperative bartender]] in [[Reelo Baruk]]'s cantina on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

[[Fay]] was also famous for never raising a lightsaber. She used the Force to bring harmony rather than fighting, and if needed, fought using only the Force. In fact, it is unknown whether she actually ''carried'' a lightsaber.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
In [[Roan Novachez]]'s second year of instruction at the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Garfield|Mr. Garfield]] gave his students a take-home quiz on [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber dueling]] skills. Roan received a "B" on the quiz, having incorrectly answered the question "What is the first Form to use in a real life lightsaber duel?" He answered "[[Form II/Legends|Form II - Makashi Form]]" but Mr. Garfield felt the correct answer was "Form Zero: Find a nonviolent solution."
{{Noncanonend}}
